scientific_integrity: Exact universal statements are analytically proved using spectral Vandermonde algebra, strict log-concavity, and uniform triangular Riemann sums. The finite regression checker is supplementary, and independent mathematical validation has not been performed. Historical equivalence cannot be exhaustively excluded.
scientific_limitations: D-optimality is for a fixed endpoint, the first m normalized-path eigenmodes, m consecutive uniformly spaced heat observations, and equal-variance sampling; it is not a condition-number optimum or an unrestricted sensor/time design. The m/N limit assumes m tends to infinity.
title: Optimal heat-sampling intervals on normalized paths: a bandwidth crossover
